extras.unavailable: Import images, a folder or a ZIP in the desktop app to start a batch.
extras.rulesBody: Uses the same IS-Net weights and input size as single-image processing. Saves transparent PNGs individually, adding a number for duplicate names without overwriting files.

copy.title: Batch jobs
copy.intro: Choose images, a folder or a ZIP and an output folder to create transparent PNGs. ZIP export can start while processing continues.
copy.zipHint: Export includes jobs present when started and waits for unfinished images. Pausing stops the export.
copy.emptyHint: Choose images, a folder or a ZIP, then select a folder for the results.
copy.recovery: Processing is paused. Resolve the error, then retry failed images or resume. Saved results are kept.
copy.pauseHint: Pause takes effect after the current image finishes.

copy.folderSkipped_other: Skipped {{count}} unsupported files, links or unreadable entries.
copy.folderHint: Includes PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, BMP, TIFF, ICO, TGA, DDS, PNM, QOI and Farbfeld in subfolders. Skips links and the output subfolder within the source.
